# YoniDev — Yonatan Yaglnik

## Who

Yonatan Yaglnik (יונתן יגלניק), known publicly as **YoniDev**, is a Full-Stack
software developer based in Jerusalem, Israel. He builds production-grade web
applications, AI-powered tools, real-time systems, automations, and bots.

- Public name: Yonatan Yaglnik / YoniDev
- Role: Full-Stack Developer (independent / freelance)
- Location: Jerusalem, Israel
- Languages: Hebrew (native), English (fluent)
- Availability: open to freelance and contract work, remote worldwide and on-site in Israel
- Contact: yonidev0101@gmail.com
- Website: https://yonidev.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/yonidev
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/yonidev

## What he does

YoniDev specializes in five overlapping areas:

1. **Full-Stack web development** — modern React / Next.js apps with TypeScript,
   server actions, App Router, and full backend integration. Performance,
   accessibility, and SEO are first-class concerns rather than afterthoughts.

2. **AI integration** — production LLM features using OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini,
   text-embedding-3, Whisper) and Anthropic Claude. Patterns include RAG over
   MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, multi-provider fallback chains, structured-output
   JSON validation, semantic search, content moderation, and AI agents that route
   user queries to the right handler.

3. **Automation & bots** — WhatsApp bots via Baileys, Telegram bots, scheduled
   workers, scrapers, integrations with Gmail / Google Calendar / Drive, MQTT
   smart-home control, and natural-language automation engines.

4. **Real-time systems** — Socket.IO multiplayer games, Server-Sent Events buses,
   live presence, persistent WebSocket clients (e.g., civil-defense alerts).

5. **Native desktop apps** — Tauri 2.0 with Rust backends, calling native OS APIs,
   wrapping CLI tools (Git), and shipping cross-platform installers.

## Services for clients

- Custom web applications (Next.js, full-stack)
- AI integrations and chatbots in Hebrew and English
- WhatsApp / Telegram business bots with memory and CRM
- Automation pipelines (Google Workspace, MQTT, CRON workers)
- REST API design and implementation
- Performance audits and re-architecture of existing apps

Typical engagement: discovery → proposal → iterative delivery → production deploy.
Stack chosen per project; defaults to Next.js + TypeScript + MongoDB on Vercel.

## Notable projects

### Yoniverse OS — personal AI operating system
A Turbo monorepo with 10 apps and services. A central **Brain server**
(Fastify v5 + MongoDB + multi-provider LLM) orchestrates a Windows desktop
overlay (Tauri 2.0 + Rust), an Android app (Flutter + Riverpod), a WhatsApp
bot (Baileys), and ESP32 smart-home devices over MQTT. The Brain runs
node-cron analyzers that push proactive insights (morning briefings, follow-up
detection, calendar conflicts) via an SSE event bus. Multi-LLM fallback chain:
OpenAI → OpenRouter → Gemini. Clerk JWT shared across every surface.

### al-hamacom702 — Jerusalem community portal
Next.js 15 App Router with a dynamic `[siteArea]` segment serving multiple
Jerusalem neighborhoods from one codebase. Five modules: forum, classifieds,
real estate, business directory, profiles. Semantic search via OpenAI
text-embedding-3-large (3072 dims) on MongoDB Atlas Vector Search. Cardcom Low
Profile payments with automatic Israeli hashbonit (tax invoice) generation.
Upstash Redis sliding-window rate limiting with 20+ tiers. NextAuth.js v4 with
Google OAuth + credentials + reCAPTCHA v3. PWA via next-pwa with push.

### AI WhatsApp Business Bot
A bot that listens to business WhatsApp chats, embeds every message
asynchronously (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dims) into MongoDB Atlas
Vector Search, and answers Hebrew natural-language questions about the
conversation history. Dual-LLM strategy: Claude Sonnet primary (better Hebrew),
GPT-4o-mini fallback. Whisper voice-message transcription. Entity extraction
builds cumulative per-person profiles. Nightly GPT-4o digest merges aliases and
emits proactive insights. Real-time Oref / Tzofar civil-defense alerts via a
persistent WebSocket to tzevaadom.co.il. Fastify admin dashboard with timing-safe
PIN auth.

### Categories Game — real-time multiplayer Hebrew word game
Digital adaptation of ארץ עיר (Eretz Ir). Authoritative server state in a
Node.js Map, broadcast over Socket.IO. End-of-round answer validation pipeline:
letter-rule check → OpenAI structured-JSON category-fit validation → cross-player
duplicate detection. Hebrew final-letter normalization. Three-tier optional
persistence (memory → MongoDB → Redis pub/sub). Deployed via Railway Dockerfiles.

### GitExplorer — desktop file explorer with built-in Git client
Tauri 2.0 + React 19 + Rust. The Rust layer executes 60+ Git CLI operations
through `std::process::Command`; React renders color-coded status badges in
the file tree. Full RTL Hebrew UI via Tailwind 4 with tailwindcss-rtl. 15
domain-specific React hooks. Persistent navigation state via
@tauri-apps/plugin-store. GitHub CLI integration creates and pushes new repos
in one click.

## Tech he works with

**Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, HTML/CSS.

**Frontend:** React 18/19, Next.js 13/14/15/16 (App Router), Tailwind CSS 3/4,
shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, Zustand, Vite.

**Backend:** Node.js, Fastify, Express, Socket.IO, MongoDB / MongoDB Atlas,
Mongoose, PostgreSQL, Redis (Upstash), MQTT (Mosquitto).

**AI & data:** OpenAI (GPT-4o family, embeddings, Whisper, structured outputs),
Anthropic Claude (Sonnet/Opus), Gemini, OpenRouter, MongoDB Vector Search,
LangChain patterns (handwritten, not the SDK).

**Desktop & native:** Tauri 2.0, Rust (Tokio async, windows crate), Flutter.

**Infra:** Vercel, Railway, Docker, Raspberry Pi deployments, Cloudinary,
Resend, Cardcom payments.

**Auth:** NextAuth.js, Clerk, JWT, OAuth.

## How to work with YoniDev

The best way to start a project is to write to **yonidev0101@gmail.com** with:
1. A short description of the problem you want to solve.
2. The current state — is it a new idea or an existing system?
3. Timeline and constraints (deadline, budget range, must-have integrations).

Yonatan replies in Hebrew or English, schedules a discovery call, and produces
a written proposal before any work begins.
